title: Vern P. Stanfill
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Married Alicia Cox, Dec. 17, 1980; Salt Lake Temple; four children.
Bachelor of Science degree in Agricultural Economics from Brigham Young University.
Managed family ranch in Montana; Managed portfolio of real estate and financial instruments.
Elders Quorum President, Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President and Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy, 2015 - present.
